'''Fusai''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the remote [[Fusai sector/Legends|Fusai sector]]. It was the location of a branch of the [[Obroa-skai/Legends|Obroa-skai]] library, where a [[BRT supercomputer/Legends|BRT supercomputer]] called [[Mistress Mnemos]] was installed about [[200 BBY/Legends|200 BBY]]. Although Obroa-skai closed the branch, it was maintained locally. Fusai became a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Safe world/Legends|safe world]], and it was here [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]] reported to Mistress Mnemos the incidents that occurred to [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] and [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]] on [[Vorzyd V/Legends|Vorzyd V]], where they faced the minion of [[Cronal|Blackhole]]. In addition to recording mission details, Mistress Mnemos helped the Alliance with tactics and long-term planning.
